scripts.db:start: docker compose up -d pocketbase && npm run db:migrations:up && npm run db:superuser:seed
scripts.db:migrations:new: docker compose exec pocketbase pocketbase --dir=/pb_data --migrationsDir=/pb_migrations migrate create
scripts.db:migrations:collections: docker compose exec pocketbase pocketbase --dir=/pb_data --migrationsDir=/pb_migrations migrate collections
scripts.db:migrations:up: docker compose exec pocketbase pocketbase --dir=/pb_data --migrationsDir=/pb_migrations migrate up
scripts.db:superuser:seed: sh -c 'set -a; . apps/api/.env; set +a; if [ -z "$POCKETBASE_SUPERUSER_EMAIL" ] || [ -z "$POCKETBASE_SUPERUSER_PASSWORD" ]; then echo "Missing POCKETBASE_SUPERUSER_EMAIL or POCKETBASE_SUPERUSER_PASSWORD in apps/api/.env"; exit 1; fi; docker compose exec pocketbase pocketbase --dir=/pb_data --migrationsDir=/pb_migrations superuser upsert "$POCKETBASE_SUPERUSER_EMAIL" "$POCKETBASE_SUPERUSER_PASSWORD"'
